_doc: T20 B2: one-shot Brief lengths, shared by tests/api/test_t20_brief_limit.py and web/tests/brief-limit.test.tsx so the server and the Brief form are checked against the same cases. A case's text is prefix + unit repeated `repeat` times + suffix; `length` is its count in Unicode code points (Python len, JavaScript Array.from), raw and untrimmed. The limit is 500.

cases.name: 500 with leading and trailing whitespace and newlines
500 as 250 letters with a combining acute accent
502 as 251 letters with a combining acute accent
